annotations.title: Test a write against a list's rules

description: A dry run of one write against a list's write rules (or candidate rules), using the list's live data: whether it would be allowed, which statement decided, and what every statement evaluated to. Nothing is written. Describe the write with itemId (the existing item, for update, delete and restore) and new, patch or merge. The token needs update on the list. 1 request, plus 1 per item the rules look up. To check syntax and the stored tests without live data, the JSONPad docs server's check_write_rules costs nothing.

identityId.description: Make the write as this identity

itemId.description: The existing item (for update, delete and restore): its data and metadata are the old state

list.description: The list: its id or pathName

merge.description: A merge applied to the old data to make the new data, instead of new

new.description: The item's data after the write

now.description: The time the rules see as now (ISO 8601)

old.description: The item's data before the write, instead of itemId's

patch.description: A JSON Patch applied to the old data to make the new data, instead of new

pointer.description: For a write to part of the data: its JSON pointer

rules.description: Candidate rules to test instead of the saved ones

name: test_list_rules
title: Test a write against a list's rules
